message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -perm -111 | grep -E 'wpantund-fuzz|build' | head -50 && ls -la wpantund/src/wpantund/wpantund-fuzz 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,120p' build.sh` executed with exit code 0.

function.arguments: {"command":"cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -perm -111 | grep -E 'wpantund-fuzz|build' | head -50 && ls -la wpantund/src/wpantund/wpantund-fuzz 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,120p' build.sh","is_input":"false"}
function.name: execute_bash

content:
./libfuzzer/build.sh
./build.sh
./afl/qemu_mode/build_qemu_support.sh
./wpantund/.travis/check-android-build
./wpantund/etc/build-in-docker.sh
FUZZ_CFLAGS="${CFLAGS}"
FUZZ_CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS}"
unset CFLAGS
unset CXXFLAGS
./bootstrap.sh
./configure                                       --enable-fuzz-targets                     --disable-shared                          --enable-static                                   CC="${CC}"                                      CXX="${CXX}"                                    FUZZ_LIBS="${LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE}"               FUZZ_CFLAGS="${FUZZ_CFLAGS}"                    FUZZ_CXXFLAGS="${FUZZ_CXXFLAGS}"                LDFLAGS="-lpthread"                             CXXFLAGS="-stdlib=libc++"
make -j$(nproc)
find . -name '*[-_]fuzz' -type f -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*[-_]fuzz.dict' -type f -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*[-_]fuzz.options' -type f -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
for f in etc/fuzz-corpus/*[-_]fuzz
do
    fuzzer=$(basename $f)
    if test -d "${f}"
        then zip -j $OUT/${fuzzer}_seed_corpus.zip ${f}/*
    fi
done
find $OUT -type f > /dev/stderr

extras.command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -perm -111 | grep -E 'wpantund-fuzz|build' | head -50 && ls -la wpantund/src/wpantund/wpantund-fuzz 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,120p' build.sh
